document.title: Advertising aimed at children
document.question:
Advertising aimed at children, such as adverts for toys, snacks and mobile games, is now common on television and online. Some people believe that this kind of advertising should be completely banned.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
